The decomposition block begins with "Public sector debt" and runs through "Residual, including asset changes." Non-year summary columns "Average 5/" and "Standard Deviation 5/" were ignored for target-year selection. Page 71 contains Table 4d, a sensitivity analysis table, and was not used as the decomposition table.
